content.short: Rebalance Finance is a DeFi protocol offering 25-30% higher APY, profit harmonization for large deposits, and diversification via RWA strategies.
content.description: Rebalance Finance is a trustless DeFi protocol built to target higher returns with disciplined risk management. It claims 25-30% higher APY than the lending market maximum, harmonizes profits for deposits over $1M, and incorporates real-world asset (RWA) strategies to counter DeFi profit declines while broadening diversification. The project is fully decentralized and uses automated strategies enabled by oracle infrastructure as part of a formal collaboration with a leading oracle provider.
